notes:
Product & ops want robust post-call summaries + QA notes for 3k agents. Primary ask: accurate transcript -> condensed summary + coaching highlights (top 3 coaching points) + QA pass/fail and score breakdown. Must integrate to their Agent Toolbar (websocket streaming for real-time assist) and also backfill nightly batch for older calls.

Key quote from CTO: "We need consistent summaries across accents and noisy lines — accuracy > 92% on intent and action items. If summaries miss action items, ops will reject."

POC constraints: must show stable throughput at 3x peak weekday spikes (they see daily peaks at 11am PST, ~1.2M tokens/hour incoming), and graceful degradation via fallback models. Cost sensitivity at token-level but willing to pay for predictable latency and SLA.

Integration notes: current stack: Twilio -> custom media pipeline -> S3 calls. Wants Redwood to accept raw wavs + real-time chunks. Also requires KMS integration and audit logs for compliance. Legal needs redaction and retention controls (30/90/365 options). SE asked for sample wavs and codec matrix (sent).
technical_requirements_summary:
- Real-time streaming ingest (WebSocket)
- Batch backfill pipeline for historical calls
- P99 latency target for streaming assist: <800ms for first token at 95% of requests
- Throughput: sustain 1.5M tokens/hour baseline, handle 3x spikes
- Support for quantized model variants for cost control
- Fallback routing to smaller model under overload

Metrics: summary fidelity (human eval), QA scoring alignment, token cost per call, p99 latency during simulated spikes. Deliverables: dashboard, sample summaries, failure-mode report.
